title: Iterative Methods for Computing the T-Square Root of Third-Order Tensors
summary: We develop and analyze iterative methods for computing the principal square root of third-order tensors under the T-product framework. Tensor extensions of the Newton iteration (quadratic convergence) and the Denman--Beavers iteration (geometric convergence with simultaneous computation of the inverse square root) are proposed, with rigorous convergence guarantees established via the Fourier-domain block-diagonalization of the T-product.
